title: Closing the main bank moves the bills paid from it to the new main bank too; the person can end any of them (V, corrected reading)
story: Switching banks, as close_main_bank. Set up Mon 11 Jan 2027, the day after pay: the old bank (the main bank) holds 200,000, of which Food 40,000 and Free to spend 60,000 (typed); a new bank opens the same day at 0. Pay of 250,000 on the 10th (moved earlier). Two bills are paid from the old bank: the phone, 8,000 on the 27th, and the gym, 5,000 on the 20th. On Fri 15 Jan the person closes the old bank: the closing moves its 200,000 to the new bank (close:old), they pick the new bank as the main bank, and the main bank, Food, Free to spend, the pay and the bills move to it; at the closing they end the gym (they are leaving it). The file is the copy after the closing: the pay and the phone are on the new bank; the gym stays on the old bank and ends with it on the closing day. Every amount is made up.

events.note: the closing moves the old bank's money out
